findings.title: Give repeated-person chat rows visible context
findings.visible: R shows two Marco rows with different previews and no conversation label. The supplied real-account image is missing, so its hidden cause remains unconfirmed.
findings.proposal: Add a compact context line to private inbox rows, identifying the conversation type and the relevant listing, project or group without merging histories.
findings.confidence: high for the local reproduction; unconfirmed for the supplied installed build
findings.diagnosis: Task-local typed results identify separate Resource and participation chat kinds. Reversed Project/Tavolo requests retain one pair conversation; 24 native composite keys remain distinct through pagination. These checks do not establish the hidden cause in the missing installed-app reference.

findings.title: Use the discovery name in Settings
findings.visible: The setting says “Modalità Co-creazione”, while the feature and help describe “Trova persone”.
findings.proposal: Rename this setting to “Trova persone (sperimentale)”.

findings.title: Replace lifecycle jargon in the management menu
findings.visible: The menu labels an ordinary organizer action “Dettagli del progetto e ciclo di vita”.
findings.proposal: Rename this menu item to “Dettagli e stato del progetto”.

findings.title: Shorten the Resource search hint
findings.visible: The default Italian search placeholder is truncated to “Cerca nel titolo e nella descrizio…”.
findings.proposal: Use “Cerca un annuncio” as the placeholder, retaining the existing title-and-description search behavior.

findings.title: Keep the full privacy audience statement visible
findings.visible: The private-note helper ends with an ellipsis at default text size, hiding the end of the audience explanation.
findings.proposal: Allow the note privacy helper to wrap to show the complete sentence.

findings.title: Call the listing an annuncio
findings.visible: The agreement sheet says “Il proprietario della lista fornisce”, using lista for the listing.
findings.proposal: Replace this label with “Il proprietario dell’annuncio offre”.

findings.title: Format People chat timestamps for reading
findings.visible: General and numbered chat messages show full numeric dates with six fractional-second digits. This makes routine message metadata unnecessarily long.
findings.proposal: Use the existing localized compact message date/time format for People chat metadata, omitting seconds and microseconds.

findings.title: Give post authors a management action
findings.visible: Maya sees Mi interessa and a private request field on her own published post. My posts separately identifies her as its owner.
findings.proposal: When the active user owns a People post, replace its interest form with a Gestisci il tuo annuncio link to the existing own-post controls.

findings.title: Explain People close and withdraw confirmations
findings.visible: The close page repeats Chiudi for its title, toolbar exit and main button. The withdrawal page similarly shows only Ritira. Neither identifies the affected conversation/post or explains the consequence.
findings.proposal: Add clear action/consequence confirmations for closing a People contact or withdrawing interest. Use currently authorized post/contact context when available, preserve identity-only recovery privacy, and distinguish the action from Annulla.

findings.title: Show inbox empty states only when all sections are empty
findings.visible: Teo has a pending People request above Nessun messaggio. Iris has an accepted contact and unread badge above Ancora nessuna chat privata. Both screens contradict their visible content.
findings.proposal: Compute the inbox empty state across native, People and discussion sections, showing it only after all applicable sections have loaded and are empty.

findings.title: Name the numbered-group exit correctly
findings.visible: A numbered group chat and its exit page say Lascia la comunità, although the warning describes leaving this group and retaining other groups. This can look like a broader community exit.
findings.proposal: Use Lascia il gruppo on numbered-group chat and exit controls, reserving Lascia la comunità for the hub exit. Keep the existing access and archive rules.

findings.title: Show template duration in hours and minutes
findings.visible: The template detail displays Durata indicativa: 10800.0 secondi. This requires mental conversion and exposes unnecessary numeric precision.
findings.proposal: Format template durations in localized hours and minutes, for example Durata indicativa: 3 ore, while keeping the stored duration unchanged.

findings.title: Translate the safety request target label
findings.visible: An Italian review-request card contains the English target label Resource request.
findings.proposal: Localize the resource-request target label as Richiesta Scambio-Dona in the safety request list.

findings.title: Show every witness response in full
findings.visible: All three witness-response buttons cut off their Italian sentences. A safety response should be readable before selection.
findings.proposal: Allow the three witness-response labels to wrap and grow vertically so each complete existing sentence is visible at default and increased text sizes.

findings.title: Keep submitted People reports readable in My reports
findings.visible: The report receipt succeeds, then My reports displays a read failure.
findings.proposal: Complete the own-report projection for People targets so it returns a privacy-safe localized summary accepted by the existing parser, with regression coverage for a newly submitted People report.
findings.diagnosis: A separate ordinary Iris v4 RPC read returns a cocreate_post row with target_summary=null. The current mobile parser requires bounded nonempty text. This supports a projection/parser contract defect; it is not visible in the screenshot itself.

findings.title: Name General history correctly
findings.visible: The Generale chat footer says Cronologia completa dell’Idea, although this is the Group General conversation.
findings.proposal: Use the General-specific history label in General conversations while retaining the existing access warning.

findings.title: Remove the raw creator UUID from Idea discovery
findings.visible: Before joining an Idea, Dario sees Creatore dell’Idea followed by a 36-character profile UUID.
findings.proposal: Replace the UUID line with Creatore: disponibile nella vista Persone autorizzata when no authorized display name is already available. Keep the current read permissions and avoid adding profile or roster lookups.
findings.diagnosis: Current source intentionally avoids an additional profile lookup. The proposed copy keeps that privacy boundary.

findings.title: Describe invalid codes accurately
findings.visible: Fresh 000000 is described only as expired. The actual delivered code still worked immediately afterward, so requesting another code was unnecessary.
findings.proposal: For the ambiguous backend OTP error, use “Il codice non è valido o è scaduto. Controllalo o richiedine uno nuovo.”
findings.confidence: high for observed behavior; backend error classification is ambiguous

findings.title: Show the complete profile-name validation
findings.visible: The display-name validation message ends in an ellipsis before explaining the complete whitespace restriction.
findings.proposal: Allow the existing display-name validation error to wrap onto enough lines to show its complete text.

findings.title: Localize the generic blocking target
findings.visible: The Italian blocking confirmation is titled “Bloccare this user?”.
findings.proposal: Replace the hardcoded English fallback “this user” with the localized Italian generic “questo utente”, retaining the existing privacy boundary.
findings.confidence: high; hardcoded fallback verified in BlockingActionButton

findings.title: Label public Group saves accurately
findings.visible: The departure dialog for a published Group offers “Salva bozza”, while the editor explains that saving updates the public page immediately. This can mislead an organizer about visibility.
findings.proposal: For published Groups, label this departure action “Salva modifiche pubbliche”; retain “Salva bozza” only for private drafts.
findings.confidence: high; published editor and shared departure label verified
